author: KEXP
description: Hailing from Yogyakarta Indonesia, the power trio Grrrl Gang rises with infectious pop melodies. With host Diana Ratsamee, they share a performance of "Lapdog" and more.
title: Grrrl Gang performs "Lapdog" & more Live on KEXP
